deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

labels.description:
The labels associated with this job. You can use these to organize and group your jobs.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.description: The location of the transcoding job resource.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

template_id.description:
Specify the templateId to use for populating Job.config.
The default is preset/web-hd, which is the only supported preset.

config.ad_breaks.start_time_offset.description: Start time in seconds for the ad break, relative to the output file timeline

config.edit_list.description: List of input assets stored in Cloud Storage.

config.edit_list.inputs.description: List of values identifying files that should be used in this atom.

config.edit_list.key.description: A unique key for this atom.

config.edit_list.start_time_offset.description: Start time in seconds for the atom, relative to the input file timeline. The default is '0s'.

config.elementary_streams.description: List of input assets stored in Cloud Storage.

config.elementary_streams.key.description: A unique key for this atom.

config.elementary_streams.audio_stream.b.description: Audio bitrate in bits per second.

config.elementary_streams.audio_stream.c.description: Number of audio channels. The default is '2'.
A list of channel names specifying layout of the audio channels. The default is ["fl", "fr"].
The codec for this audio stream. The default is 'aac'.

config.elementary_streams.audio_stream.s.description: The audio sample rate in Hertz. The default is '48000'.

config.elementary_streams.video_stream.h.description: The video bitrate in bits per second.
Target CRF level. The default is '21'.
The entropy coder to use. The default is 'cabac'.
The target video frame rate in frames per second (FPS).
Select the GOP size based on the specified duration. The default is '3s'.
The height of the video in pixels.
Pixel format to use. The default is 'yuv420p'.
Enforces the specified codec preset. The default is 'veryfast'.
Specify the mode. The default is 'vbr'.
Initial fullness of the Video Buffering Verifier (VBV) buffer in bits.
Size of the Video Buffering Verifier (VBV) buffer in bits.
The width of the video in pixels.
HLG color format setting for H264.
SDR color format setting for H264.

config.encryptions.description: List of encryption configurations for the content.

config.encryptions.id.description: Identifier for this set of encryption options.

config.encryptions.drm_systems.description: DRM system(s) to use; at least one must be specified. If a DRM system is omitted, it is considered disabled.

config.encryptions.secret_manager_key_so.description: Configuration for secrets stored in Google Secret Manager.
The name of the Secret Version containing the encryption key in the following format: projects/{project}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version_number}.

config.inputs.description: List of input assets stored in Cloud Storage.

config.inputs.key.description: A unique key for this input. Must be specified when using advanced mapping and edit lists.

config.inputs.uri.description:
URI of the media. Input files must be at least 5 seconds in duration and stored in Cloud Storage (for example, gs://bucket/inputs/file.mp4).
If empty, the value is populated from Job.input_uri.

config.manifests.file_name.description: The name of the generated file. The default is 'manifest'.

config.manifests.mux_streams.description: List of user supplied MuxStream.key values that should appear in this manifest.

config.manifests.type.description: Type of the manifest. Possible values: ["MANIFEST_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "HLS", "DASH"]

config.mux_streams.container.description: The container format. The default is 'mp4'.

config.mux_streams.elementary_streams.description: List of ElementaryStream.key values multiplexed in this stream.

config.mux_streams.encryption_id.description: Identifier of the encryption configuration to use.

config.mux_streams.file_name.description: The name of the generated file.

config.mux_streams.key.description: A unique key for this multiplexed stream.

config.mux_streams.segment_settings.description: Segment settings for ts, fmp4 and vtt.

config.mux_streams.segment_settings.segm.description: Duration of the segments in seconds. The default is '6.0s'.

config.output.description: Location of output file(s) in a Cloud Storage bucket.

config.output.uri.description: URI for the output file(s). For example, gs://my-bucket/outputs/.

config.overlays.description: List of overlays on the output video, in descending Z-order.

config.overlays.animations.description: List of animations. The list should be chronological, without any time overlap.

config.overlays.animations.animation_fad.description: Display overlay object with fade animation.
The time to end the fade animation, in seconds.

Required. Type of fade animation: 'FADE_IN' or 'FADE_OUT'.
The possible values are:

* 'FADE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED': The fade type is not specified.

* 'FADE_IN': Fade the overlay object into view.

* 'FADE_OUT': Fade the overlay object out of view. Possible values: ["FADE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "FADE_IN", "FADE_OUT"]
The time to start the fade animation, in seconds.
Normalized coordinates based on output video resolution.

config.overlays.image.uri.description: URI of the image in Cloud Storage. For example, gs://bucket/inputs/image.png.

config.pubsub_destination.topic.description: The name of the Pub/Sub topic to publish job completion notification to. For example: projects/{project}/topics/{topic}.
